stops.name: Alpsee
stops.detail: The Alpsee is an 88-hectare lake in Bavaria in the district of Ostallgäu.

stops.name: Hohenschwangau
stops.detail: It has a circumference of 4.70 kilometers, belongs to the municipality of Schwangau and is located in the immediate vicinity of the royal castles of Hohenschwangau and Neuschwanstein, directly at the foot of the mountain Säuling.

stops.name: Alpseebad
stops.detail: The lake is considered one of the cleanest lakes in Germany and is used in summer as a bathing lake in a specially created bathing establishment (Alpseebad, on the south shore).
